name: callout
label: Point at one region of a screen recording: a box draws around it, a spotlight dims the rest, or an arrow points from a label

variant.label: box = an outline draws round the region with a label tab, spotlight = the rest of the frame dims, arrow = a label with an arrow that draws to the region

region.label: The region in frame pixels: x,y,w,h

label_side.label: Where the label sits (auto = where there is room)

zoom.label: A hint for the video builder: how much to push into the region (1 = none). The comp itself never scales the footage

out.label: edge = leave at out_at, cut = hold to the end

out_at.label: edge: when it leaves (blank = 0.4 s before the end)
